itens.trecho: Português Um excelente filme psicológico Este talvez seja um dos filmes de mistério mais interessantes e populares da década de 2000. Dirigido por Gore Verbinski, adapta ao cinema ocidental um filme de terror psicológico japonês baseado num livro de Koji Suzuki.

Is she still in the dark place? After the mysterious death of her niece Katie, journalist Rachel Keller starts to investigate an urban legend about a videotape which kills you seven days after watching it. With dire consequences coming her way if she can not solve the mystery....

Was interesting and special effects were good but all comes down to story and they lost the plot at the end, sorry. Didn't make sense they seemed like they had a good idea and wanted to make a horror out of it when the obvious ending would have worked out better. Nice try!
